title: Signature Loudness Normalization
description: Signature-original: Measures integrated loudness and applies gain so programs match the platform target without pumping. Recorded facts — Check: Loudness Normalization; Standard: EBU R128 / ATSC A/85; Criterion: -16 LUFS +/-1 (streaming). Used by mastering engineers, broadcast operations, and streaming platforms to reject bad files before air. Built as a Signature-authored original for the JAH network; clearly labeled Signature and never presented as a public record.
demo:
# Signature Loudness Normalization — runnable demo (python3)
# Loudness Normalization - loudness compliance (python3)
lufs=-16.2
true_peak=-1.3
target=-16.0
print("integrated loudness: %.1f LUFS (target %.1f)" % (lufs, target))
print("true peak: %.1f dBTP" % true_peak)
ok = abs(lufs-target) <= 1.0 and true_peak <= -1.0
print("COMPLIANT" if ok else "NON-COMPLIANT")
